mission: Trace ONE reader journey to the bottom: the 'my bill went up — why? — what do I do?' lifecycle across 14 assigned pages of utilityexplained.com (list in context) per .squad/SQ-065/audit-prompt.md. For each page: a standard audit entry. Then walk the actual pathway a stressed reader would take: start at 03-why-is-my-electric-bill-so-high (diagnose) -> dispute/shutoff/protection pages (act) -> budgeting/moving/assistance (plan) -> net-metering/EV/rates (forward-looking). At each hop, FOLLOW the real internal links in the markdown and record: does the page link to the logical next step? Are there dead ends (0 useful onward links)? Broken/wrong-target links? Pages that answer the same intermediate question twice (split pathways)? Deliver a PATHWAY MAP: the journey as a directed graph in text, every dead end, every missing edge that should exist (page A should link to B because a reader of A needs B). Write everything to .squad/SQ-065/wave1/tracer-journey.md.
